summary_1line: Hanuman enters Lanka at night, marvels at its splendor, confronts the city’s guardian goddess, defeats her, and receives a prophecy of Ravana’s impending downfall.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman stands on a height at night gazing over Lanka’s golden walls, gem-studded gates, and torchlit palaces shining beside the dark sea.
The monstrous guardian goddess of Lanka rises before the gate and strikes Hanuman with her palm as he roars in defiance.
After being struck down, the defeated goddess of Lanka lies on the ground pleading while Hanuman stands over her beneath the starry night.
